articles.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
articles.snippet: Attackers drained Duelbits' hot wallets across four blockchains; about $6 million in stolen funds now sits in a single Ethereum address.

articles.title: Kalshi says CFTC hasn’t contacted it over ‘unusual’ $5B trading activity
articles.snippet: Kalshi said nearly $5 billion in similarly sized Ether perpetual trades reflected its liquidity incentive programs and rejected allegations that the activity was wash trading.

articles.title: In Her Final Weeks, SEC's Peirce Calls for Ending the KYC 'Panopticon'
articles.snippet: In one of her final speeches as commissioner, Peirce argued that regulators' "data haystacks" endanger the people they aim to protect—as recent KYC leaks expose crypto holders to phishing and physical attacks.

articles.title: £10K Reward Offered After UK Couple Attacked in Crypto Home Invasion
articles.snippet: Police believe the robbery was planned and targeted, with instructions relayed to the three attackers by a fourth man on a video call.

articles.title: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool
articles.snippet: OpenAI is giving Ukraine's government access to Daybreak, its AI vulnerability-hunting system, as the country's cyber defenders face a record wave of attacks on hospitals, power grids, and government networks.
